## 1. Modifying Slides · 课件制作与幻灯片调整

### 1.1 Add a New Slide with Vocabulary & Chinese Pop-ups (添加带生词注释的幻灯片)
> Use this when you want to introduce a new historical concept or story during class.

```text
Add a slide to the [Unit name, e.g. Egypt / Rome / Greece] slides about [Topic, e.g. mummification and the afterlife]. Write 3 short bullet points in simple English for middle school learners, gloss the key words with Chinese pop-ups, and add teacher speaking notes at the bottom.
```

### 1.2 Add a Classroom Countdown Timer (添加课堂活动计时器)
> Use this when setting a timed group activity, challenge, or quick brainstorm.

```text
Add a [10 / 15]-minute countdown timer to the group activity slide in the [Unit name] slides, and make sure it chime when it reaches zero.
```

### 1.3 Add an Interactive Voting Poll (添加课堂触摸互动投票)
> Use this at the end of class for a quick tap-to-vote exit ticket on the interactive board.

```text
Add an interactive multiple-choice tap-to-vote poll to the end of the [Unit name] lesson slides with 3 options to check student understanding, followed by a poll summary slide.
```

### 1.4 Add a Deep-Dive Slide (添加垂直下沉详细解析幻灯片)
> Use this when you want extra details or primary sources available without cluttering your main slide deck.

```text
Under the overview slide in the [Unit name] slides, add a vertical drill-down slide with deeper primary source evidence so I can press Down on my keyboard during class if students ask for more depth.
```

## 2. Worksheets, Handouts & Reading Sheets · 练习单与阅读材料

### 2.1 Make a Worksheet Easier for Beginner English Learners (降低练习单语言难度 / 增加支架)
> Use this when a reading sheet or worksheet is too difficult or dense for your students.

```text
Make the [Topic, e.g. Athens vs Sparta] worksheet easier for beginner English learners: use shorter sentences (under 12 words), add a word bank at the top with Chinese support, and add 3 ruled writing lines for each answer.
```

### 2.2 Add Ruled Writing Lines or Drawing Boxes (添加手写横线或绘图框)
> Use this when you want students to handwrite answers or sketch diagrams on printed copies.

```text
In the [Unit name] student worksheet, add 4 ruled handwriting lines under Question 2, and add a dot-grid drawing box under Question 3 for students to sketch their design.
```

### 2.3 Add Teacher Answer Keys (添加仅教师可见的答案与解析)
> Use this to embed sample student answers and teacher grading tips that students cannot see.

```text
Add a complete teacher answer key and look-for criteria to the [Unit name] worksheet, making sure it is wrapped inside the teacher-only section so students cannot see it.
```

---

## 3. Bilingual Co-Teaching & Chinese History · 双语共教分工

### 3.1 Draft a Lesson for Xinyi's Lead on Chinese History (为 Xinyi 设计中国史主导课件与文稿)
> Use this when preparing a unit where Xinyi leads on Chinese content and Nate provides world history connections.

```text
Draft a lesson for [Topic, e.g. Shang Dynasty oracle bones / Qin unification] where Xinyi leads the Chinese history content and Nate provides comparative world history links: include the primary Chinese historical source, clear student summaries, English MYP command terms, and bilingual discussion questions for both teachers.
```

### 3.2 Align Student Prompts with IB MYP Command Terms (与 IB 指令词规范对齐)
> Use this to train students on MYP assessment vocabulary (*Identify, Describe, Explain, Evaluate*).

```text
Review the instructions on the [Unit name] summative task and make sure all student action verbs use and define the official IB MYP Command Terms (such as Describe, Explain, or Analyse) with bilingual glosses.
```

---

## 4. Bilingual Vocabulary & Visual Cards · 双语词汇库与词卡

### 4.1 Add New Words to the Vocab App (向词汇库添加新词与图标)
> Use this whenever you teach a new unit and want students to practice words in the History Vocab app.

```text
Add "[Word 1, e.g. pharaoh]" and "[Word 2, e.g. dynasty]" to our course vocabulary list with simple English definitions (under 75 characters), Chinese translations, and minimalist SVG icons, then validate the list.
```

### 4.2 Generate Printable Flashcards or Quizlet/Kahoot Files (导出练习卡片与复习游戏)
> Use this to export flashcards or classroom review games before an assessment.

```text
Export our [Unit name] vocabulary list into Quizlet and Kahoot spreadsheet format so we can run a review game in class.
```

---

## 5. Daily Git Sync, Packets & Publishing · 保存、合包与发布上线

### 5.1 Check What Happened Before You Start (开始前检查最新更新)
> Always send this first when opening a new AI session to see what Nate, Xinyi, or other AIs worked on.

```text
Show me the recent entries from AI-ACTIVITY-LOG.md and tell me what Nate, Xinyi, or other AI assistants have worked on before we begin.
```

### 5.2 Rebuild the Unit Packet PDF (重新生成单元可打印合辑小册子)
> Use this whenever you finish updating worksheets and want the unit packet PDF updated for printing.

```text
I have finished updating the worksheets for [Unit 1 / Unit 2]. Please rebuild the unit packet PDF for printing.
```

### 5.3 Save Everything and Publish to the Website (保存、记录日志并发布到网站)
> Use this when you are completely done and want your changes live on the student website.

```text
I am finished with my work on [Unit name]. Please record a summary in AI-ACTIVITY-LOG.md, commit all modified files with a clear message, and push to GitHub origin main so the online student site updates.
```

:::
